title: Retain the inventory.
text: Two fixed six-level banks hold twelve nominal 3U payloads. Select one cell and inhibit host burns during feeding.

title: Capture the selected payload.
text: The guided pusher feeds the lift. At source level 5 the payload floor is Z830 mm; the lift grips hold its pallet.

title: Overlap the restraints.
text: At handoff, positive carrier bayonets and outboard lift grip pins establish dual custody. The storage banks and fixed frame are hidden in this view for access.

title: Prove the clear state.
text: Payload floor Z46 mm. Raised custody frame floor Z190 mm. Prove pallet locks, pusher withdrawal and a clear path before enabling launch.

title: Retain the pallet during recovery.
text: The payload departs along +X. Carrier and captive pallet arrest together, then return as one retained assembly for the next transfer.

title: Fault → inhibit → retain → verify.
text: Inhibit launch, retain the payload, isolate the cell, supervise reset, then verify before continuing. Physical fault-response validation is subsequent work.
